segments.sn35.126:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
segments.sn35.126:1.2: Atha kho, upāli gahapati, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho, upāli gahapati, bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.126:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
segments.sn35.126:1.4: Ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti?(Yathā purimasuttantaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
segments.sn35.126:1.6: Ayaṃ kho, gahapati, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
